---
title: Errata
toc: false
---

Published numbers and conclusions are never edited silently. When something published here
turns out to be wrong, it is corrected by an entry on this page: the date, what was said, what
is true, why, and a link to the log entry that found it. The claim concerned is marked
*retracted* or *superseded* in the [claims register](claims.qmd), and the affected page gets a
note at the top pointing here. Typos and wording are fixed without an erratum.

*No errata yet.*
